dedupe_keys.name: eu weekly oil bulletin consumer prices of petroleum products in eu countries

description: The Weekly Oil Bulletin is the European Commission's weekly publication of consumer prices of petroleum products in all EU countries, issued by the Directorate-General for Energy to improve the transparency of oil prices and strengthen the internal market. National data and prices are submitted to the Commission on Wednesdays and the bulletin is published on Thursdays, with subscribers receiving it by mail. The page holds the latest prices with taxes and without taxes as Excel files (about 17 KB each, dated 24 September 2026 when read), maps for Euro-super 95 and diesel as PDFs, and background on the value added tax, excise duties and other indirect taxes applied to petroleum products. Coverage is the European Union at national level. Access: files download from the page without registration; the page states no licence. Caveats: national average retail prices only, with no station-level or product-flow detail, and the page shows only the latest files, not the history. It suits scenario analysis of fuel price shocks and supply disruption, for example after storms or refinery outages, and relates to the EIA petroleum supply and prices record and the JODI oil database catalogued here.
